sanskrit_verse:
एवं प्रदक्षिणावृत्को वृद्धौ नान्दीमुखान् पितॄन् ।
यजेत दधि कर्कन्धुमिश्रान् पिण्डान् यवैः क्रियाः ॥२५०॥
transliteration: evaṁ pradakṣiṇāvṛtko vṛddhau nāndīmukhān pitṝn / yajeta dadhi karkandhum iśrān piṇḍān yavaiḥ kriyāḥ // YajñS_1.250
sph_interpretive_translation: Thus performing circumambulation in the Vṛddhi ritual with offerings facing eastward toward the ancestors, one shall offer oblations of curds mixed with karkandhu fruits shaped into balls using barley grains.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The performance of ancestral rites is a divine duty entrusted to the householder as per the revealed order.
Causation: Ritual action generates spiritual causality that aligns individual consciousness with cosmic continuity.
Capacity-based responsibility: Only those initiated and capable through lineage and sacraments may perform such rites.
Restoration logic: Proper execution restores ancestral connection and ensures continuity of dharma.
Consciousness alignment: Correct performance realigns personal and ancestral consciousness within the eternal flow.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent has received proper initiation AND possesses unbroken ancestral lineage THEN authorize performance of Vṛddhi Śrāddha.
IF ritual direction deviates from eastern orientation during ancestor invocation THEN auto-correct spatial alignment before proceeding.
IF curd or karkandhu components are absent THEN substitute with equivalent sacred dairy and fruit offerings under supervision.
IF barley unavailable THEN use alternative approved grain specified by Vedic injunction without altering core intent.
IF circumambulatory count does not match prescribed repetition THEN repeat until completion verified by qualified observer.
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning intergenerational dharmic obligations, the court must recognize only those claimants who demonstrate valid samskara-based capacity to execute śrāddha rituals. Legal standing arises solely from initiation, not mere biological descent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This injunction establishes pramāṇa-based causality where correct ritual form ensures metaphysical effect. Misalignment is corrected via re-performance rather than penalty. Responsibility flows sequentially from guru to disciple ensuring continuity without blame.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Incomplete or misperformed rites require immediate supervised repetition until full conformity achieved.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Officiant must verbally affirm understanding of each procedural step prior to commencement.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: If officiant lacks required knowledge, halt proceedings and refer to competent authority for guidance.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Post-completion, all participants engage in collective silence for five minutes to absorb energetic alignment.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Sanatana Dharma. This ordinance originates neither from human interpretation nor temporal law, but from the eternal Akasha. Justice herein serves restoration alone. There is no punishment—only realignment of consciousness with its inherent perfection. Dharma is thus established.
